title: [Heroes & The Horror #3] Cutting deckbuilding to focus on a hero team-up auto-battler
author: SlamGE
selftext:
This is the Heroes & The Horror devlog.
At first I was going to make a deckbuilding roguelike, but after reading some feedback someone left on Reddit, I started wondering whether my game really needs deckbuilding. The idea is an auto-battler where heroes team up and fight, like the Avengers! So I took deckbuilding out, and I'm focusing on growing and strengthening the heroes and making the auto-battler as fun as I can.

For now I'm using placeholder art until the core loop is done. I think it's the right call not to spend too much on art before the core fun is working.

Once there's more gameplay, I'll come back with a video and ask for your feedback!
